senses.gloss:
खल् खल्, cl. 1. P. खलति, चखाल, &c.,
to move, shake; to gather.

खल्ल् खल्ल्, cl. 1. A. खल्लते, &c., to
shake, be loose; [cf. खल्.]

खल खल, अस्, अम्, m. n. a threshing-floor,
a granary; earth, mould, or soil; place, site; sedi-
ment, dregs, the deposit of oil &c.; a mill; contest,
battle; (अस्, आ), m. f. a wicked or mischievous
person; low, base, inferior, cruel, mischief-making;
(अस्), m. the sun; the plant Xanthochymus Pictorius,
see तमाल; the datura plant, thorn-apple; (आ), f.
N. of a daughter of Raudrāśva.
—खल-कुल, अस्,
m. = कुलत्थ, Dolichos Uniflorus.
—खल-ज, अस्,
आ, अम्, Ved. produced on a threshing-floor.
—खल-
ता, f. or खल-त्व, अम्, n. wickedness, villainy; filthi-
ness.
—खल-धान्य, अम्, n. a threshing-floor;
(also खलधान, खलेधान्य, खलाधान.)
—खल-पू, ऊस्, ऊस्, m. f. a sweeper, a cleaner, a
Mehter or Ferash (originally ‘one who cleans a
threshing-floor’).
—खल-प्रीति, इस्, f. the friend-
ship or favour of wicked or low persons.
—खल-
मूर्ति, इस्, m. quicksilver.
—खल-संसर्ग, अस्,
m. associating with bad company.
—खलाधारा
(˚ल-आध्˚), f. a kind of cockroach.
—खले-धानी
or खले-बाली, f. the post of a threshing-floor round
which the oxen pass which tread out the grain.
—खले-बुसम्, ind. at the time when the chaff
is on the threshing-floor, at the threshing-time.
—खले-यवम्, ind. at the time when barley is
on the threshing-floor, at the barley threshing-time.
—खले-वाली, f. the post of a threshing-floor; [cf.
खले-धानी.]
—खलोक्ति (˚ल-उक्˚), इस्, f. abuse,
low or wicked language.

खल्ल खल्ल, अस्, m. a little case or cap
formed by rolling up paper &c. (used for holding
any small articles of grocery &c.); a mill, a stone or
vessel for grinding drugs; a kind of cloth or clothes;
leather, leather garments; a leather water-bag; a
canal, a cut, a creek, a trench, a deep hole; the
Cātaka, a kind of cuckoo; (ई), f. shooting pain in
the extremities.
खलि, इस्, m. sediment of oil or oil-cake.

खलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having sediment &c.; (ई), m. an
epithet of Śiva; (इनस्), m. pl., N. of a class of Dāna-
vas; (इनी), f. a multitude of threshing-floors; the plant
Anthericum Tuberosum, = ताल-पर्णी, = ताल-मूली.

खलिन, अस्, आ, अम्, covered with sediment,
covered with oil-dregs (?); (अस्, अम्), m. n. the bit
of a bridle; see खलीन; [cf. Gr. χαλινός.]
खलीन, अस्, अम्, m. n. the bit of a bridle.

खली-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्,
to reduce to sediment, to crush; to hurt, injure; to
treat badly, scorn.
—खली-कार, अस्, m. or खली-
कृति, इस्, f. reducing to sediment; hurting, injuring;
mischief, evil.

खल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, being on a threshing-floor, fit
for one; fit for oil-cake &c.; (आ), f. a multitude of
threshing-floors; N. of a woman.
खल्यका, f., N. of a woman.

खलति खलति, इस्, इस् or ई, इ (said to be fr. rt.
खल्), bald-headed, bald; [cf. कुल्व, खल्लिट, &c.]

खलतिक, अस्, m., N. of a mountain; (अम्), n.,
N. of the forest situated near this mountain.

खलिश खलिश, अस्, आ, m. f. a kind of fish,
Trichopodus Colisa; or = कङ्कत्रोट, Esox Kau-
kila; [cf. खल्लिश, खलेश, &c.]

खल्लिश खल्लिश, अस्, m. another form for
खलिश, q. v.

खलु खलु, ind. (as a particle of assevera-
tion or affirmation), indeed, verily, certainly, truly,
yes; (as a continuative particle), now, now then, now
further; (as a particle employed in syllogistic forms
of speech), but now, = the Latin atqui. It occurs
only once in the Ṛg-veda; oftener in the Brāhmaṇas
and Buddhist compositions, especially when combined
with other particles, thus अथ खलु, उ खलु,
वै खलु, and खलु वै, = now then, now further.
In later Sanskrit खलु frequently does little more
than lay stress on the word by which it is preceded,
and is sometimes merely an expletive. According
to native lexicographers खलु is also a particle of
prohibition, endearment, conciliation, and inquiry.
न खलु, by no means, not at all, indeed not.

खलुज् ख-लुज्, क्, m. (instead of ख-लुक्
fr. लुञ्च्?), darkness.

खलुरेष खलुरेष or खलुरेषक, अस्, m.
a kind of wild quadruped.

खलूरिका खलूरिका, f. a parade, a place
for military exercise; [cf. खुरली.]

खलेश खलेश or खलेशय, अस्, m. a kind
of fish, commonly Trichopodus Colisa; [cf. खलिश
and खशेट.]

खल्लातक खल्लातक, अस्, m., N. of the first
minister of king Bindusāra.

खल्लासर खल्लासर, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?),
the tenth Yoga in astronomy.
खल्लिका खल्लिका, f. a frying-pan.

खालिक खालिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. खल), like
a threshing-floor.

खल्लिट खल्लिट or खल्लीट, अस्, आ, अम्, bald-
headed, becoming morbidly bald; [cf. खलति.]

खल्व खल्व, अस्, m., Ved. a kind of grain
or leguminous plant.
खल्वट खल्वट, अस्, m. a severe cough (?).

खल्वाट खल्वाट, अस्, आ, अम्, bald, bald-
headed; [cf. खलति.]
खल्वल खल्वल, आस्, m. pl., N. of a school.

खालत्य खालत्य, अम्, n. (fr. खलति), Ved.,
or खालित्य, अम्, n. morbid baldness.

खलखलाय, Nom. A. खलखलायते, to act
knavishly.
खलाय, Nom. A. खलायते, to act roguishly.
